name: fetch_documentation_tool
description: Performs a plain HTTP GET on a URL and returns the raw response body exactly as received, with no summarization and no HTML-to-text conversion. Use this to read carrier documentation pages and any spec or URL referenced within them (e.g. a ReDoc `<redoc spec-url="...">` tag, or a Swagger UI config) — that kind of detail can be lost by tools that convert HTML into readable text. Do not use this tool to call or test the carrier partner's own API endpoints — use `http_request_tool` for that.

url.description: The documentation or specification URL to fetch.
